title: Women's Crochet – No, I Won't Make You One. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
short: No, I Won't Make You One.
who: the crocheter who has heard "can you make me one?" one too many times, zipped on for the craft night and the yarn shop.
art: A granny-square crochet sweater with a paper tag lies beside a ball of cream yarn and a crochet hook, in mustard, sage, coral and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: NO, I WON'T
inks: coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash
layout_story: NO, I WON'T runs above it in two lines and MAKE YOU ONE. below in heavy high-contrast serif capitals, the last line wider than the first
layout_faq: NO, I WON'T above the sweater and MAKE YOU ONE. below
chest: a small NO. in the same heavy serif capitals as the back
warm2: cozy craft nights, drafty yarn shops and the walk home with a new skein
gift_line: for the friend whose hook never stops and whose answer is still no.
seo_desc: A crochet zip up hoodie: NO, I WON'T MAKE YOU ONE. on the back over a granny-square sweater and yarn, plus a stitched NO. on the chest.
